audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1, 2 and 5 gave the stage to Yone while the explanation printed beside each one says the opposite: whys[1] "Level 2 stays even", whys[2] "keeping the skirmish a spacing contest", whys[5] "leaving the crit trade dead-even". Rows 3 and 4 correctly read Skill but were rated 4/10, which reads as Yone-favoured.
audit.why: The packet chart is Skill for rows 0-5 and Yone only at 2+ items, and that matches every prose field here. No mirror audit exists yet, so this page sets the shape yone__yasuo must invert.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 2 and 5 flipped to Skill in BOTH layers as one atomic group, rows 3 and 4 ratings normalised to 5/10, and row 6 rated 4/10 to reflect Yone's edge.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 stage said both ultimates "cancel out" with no numbers, when the cooldowns are far apart.
audit.why: Fate Sealed is 120/100/80s; Last Breath is 70/50/30s. You get roughly two ultimates per one of his, which is the whole reason baiting his R is the correct play rather than a coin flip.
audit.corrected: mid now states 120s against 70s so the bait-first advice has a reason attached.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page says Yone has Wind Wall — in four separate places. whys[0] "identical Q poke and Wind Wall", early "identical Wind Wall", mid "both hold Wind Wall as the trade-decider", spikes[0].text "respects the other's Wind Wall". Yone's W is Spirit Cleave: a damaging cone that shields him, scaling with champions hit, on a 14-second cooldown that shortens with attack speed. He has no projectile-blocking ability at all.
audit.why: This is the highest-value correction on the page — the reader is told to play around an enemy ability that does not exist, and to treat their single best tool as neutralised. Yone's Spirit Cleave shield is also what actually refunds your poke, and nothing on the page mentioned it.
audit.corrected: All four claims rewritten to state that Wind Wall is yours alone and to name Spirit Cleave and its 14s shield; dosFull[1].d, dosFull[2].d and dontsFull[1].d re-keyed to Q3, Spirit Cleave and Soul Unbound's 22s snap-back.

edits.before: Level 1 is a pure mirror — identical Q poke and Wind Wall, no kit edge either way.
edits.after: Level 1 is near-mirror Q poke, but only you carry Wind Wall — no edge yet.

edits.before: This is a pure mirror of mechanics — both of you stack Q for the knock-up and dash on E. Whoever weaves autos between Q casts and respects the other's Wind Wall wins the trade, so track his Q3 windup and side-step it while landing your own.
edits.after: Near-mirror mechanics — you both stack Q for the knock-up, but his W is Spirit Cleave, not a wind wall: a cone that shields him more per champion hit, on 14 seconds. Track his Q3 wind-up, side-step it, and land your own first.

edits.before: A true skill mirror at levels 1-2 — identical Q poke, identical Wind Wall. Neither of you has a kit advantage, so it comes down to last-hitting cleanly and not eating a free Q. Don't waste Wind Wall on a single Q; save it for a committed all-in.
edits.after: Near-mirror at levels 1-2 — the same Q rhythm, but Wind Wall is yours alone and his Spirit Cleave shields off the wave. It comes down to last-hitting cleanly and not eating a free Q. Don't spend the wall on one cast; save it for a committed all-in.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 remain even — both dash on E, both build to a Q3 knock-up, and both hold Wind Wall as the trade-decider. The lane is decided by micro: land your Q3 while dodging his, and never blow Wind Wall early. At 6 respect that his R and yours cancel out, so whoever forces the other's first loses tempo.
edits.after: Levels 3-6 remain even — both build to a Q3 knock-up, but only you hold Wind Wall and his Spirit Cleave shield (14s) refunds your poke. Decided by micro: land your Q3 while dodging his, and never blow the wall early. At 6 his R is 120s against your 70s, so whoever forces first loses tempo.

edits.before: Dash through the wave stacking Q, tag Yone with Q2, and only commit the EQ3 knockup when his answer is down.
edits.after: His Q3 is a dash-and-gust knock-up, not a projectile — side-step it, and never stand in the line for free.

edits.before: Yone wastes Soul Unbound — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Spirit Cleave is 14s — trade into it and his shield eats it.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Soul Unbound repeats his damage on the snap-back — 22s at rank 1.

notes: No mirror existed; this page now sets the shape yone__yasuo must invert (rows 0-5 Skill, row 6 Yone). The 'Yone has Wind Wall' claim was live in four fields and is flatly contradicted by his kit — Spirit Cleave is a shielding cone. What I did NOT assert: whether Wind Wall blocks Yone's Q3 gust. His Q carries dash/knockup/zone flags but no projectile flag, so wants.you[2], the tldr and winCon lines about 'blocking his Q3' were left untouched rather than corrected on a derived-flag absence.
